description: Make one iteration row the DEFAULT of an environment — the row a run uses — e.g. "make ITR-2 the default for SU-23 in General". Works at TEST CASE level (`entityType:"TC"` + `tcId`) and SUITE level (`entityType:"SU"` + `suiteId`). Pass the iteration by NAME (e.g. "ITR-2") or id. The previous default simply stops being the default (it is NOT deleted — delete it afterwards with testdata_delete_iterations if wanted); other environments' defaults are kept. It reads the test data back and reports the new default; asking for the row that already is the default changes nothing.

entityType.description: TC = a test case's own test data; SU = suite-level test data. Default TC.

environmentType.description: Environment key from tc_list_environments (e.g. general, general_1) — each environment has its own default.

iteration.description: The iteration to make the default: its name (e.g. "ITR-2") or id.

suiteId.description: Suite id / SU-23 (required when entityType is SU).

tcId.description: Test case id / TC-123 (required when entityType is TC).

name: testdata_set_default_iteration
title: Make a test-data iteration the default (test case or suite level)
